# Digital Petroleum (PumpSaathi)
> Cloud-based Petrol Pump Management OS (PWA & Android App) & Advisory Platform for Indian Retail Fuel Dealers.
> Tagline: Pump chalayein, hisaab hum sambhalein.

## Why Play Store Link Is Not Required (PWA + Direct Signed APK)
- Digital Petroleum (PumpSaathi) runs as an installable **Progressive Web App (PWA)** directly inside Chrome, Safari, and Edge on Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS (`app.html`) with offline capability and instant cloud sync—no Play Store download required.
- For Android users who prefer a standalone app icon, an officially digitally-signed APK (`app-release-signed.apk`) is hosted directly on our official portal.

## OMC Compatibility (BPCL, IOCL, HPCL)
- Purpose-built for independent **Indian Oil (IOCL)**, **Bharat Petroleum (BPCL)**, and **Hindustan Petroleum (HPCL)** retail fuel dealers in India.
- *Disclaimer:* Digital Petroleum is an independent SaaS technology provider and is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by BPCL, IOCL, or HPCL.

## 4 Core Pillars
1. **PumpSaathi (Core OS):** Daily nozzle meter readings (MS/HSD), shift-wise cash/UPI/card/fleet tally, underground tank dip & density reconciliation, lubricant stock tracking, 4-digit VIP Owner PIN, and 6-digit Party Portal login.
2. **CA Desk:** GST and VAT return preparation, tanker invoice vs. dip reconciliation, and clean tax accounting with Tally XML/Excel export.
3. **Legal Desk:** Legal notices and lawyer consultation for payment defaults and commercial disputes.
4. **Recovery Desk:** Structured udhaari (credit) recovery backed by digital slips, vehicle numbers, and ledger proof.

## Transparent Pricing Plans & Free Trial Policy
- **Free Trial Available:** Every petrol pump dealer can test the full workflow with a free live trial and guided WhatsApp onboarding before paying. Zero lock-in contracts.
- **Starter Pack — ₹999/month:** Full PumpSaathi Core OS (nozzle reading, shift tally, udhaari party ledger, 4-digit VIP Owner PIN, 6-digit Party Portal, and 1-click PDF/Excel daily sales reports).
- **Growth Pack — ₹2,199/month:** Everything in Starter Pack PLUS Tank Dip & Shortage Tracking, Lubricant Stock, Multi-Staff Access, Tally Export, CA Desk (GST/VAT & tanker reconciliation), Legal Desk, and Udhaari Recovery Engine.
- **Modular AI Virtual Staff Skills — ₹49 to ₹299/month:** Optional add-on AI assistants for fuel shortage alerts, automated WhatsApp udhaar recovery reminders, GST compliance help, and legal notice drafting.

## Data Security & Privacy
- Isolated per-pump cloud workspaces with 4-digit Owner PIN and 6-digit Party Code access controls.
- 100% data ownership with 1-click Excel/PDF export and zero vendor lock-in.
